$schema.description: URL of the procdeck JSON schema, for editor completion and validation.

name.description: Deck name — the tab title and the name of the installed web app. Defaults to the config directory's basename.

port.description: Port for the web UI and the `*.localhost` proxy. Defaults to 4820.

host.description: Interface the UI and proxy bind to. Defaults to "127.0.0.1" — loopback only, because the UI types into real terminals. Set "0.0.0.0" to reach the deck from another machine or from a container's host.

envFile.description: Dotenv file(s), relative to the config file's directory, whose variables every proc and preflight sees — on top of the inherited environment, below each proc's own `env`. Read at every spawn, so a refreshed file reaches a proc on its next restart; a missing file is skipped with a note in the pane.

id.description: Stable identifier: the pane label, and the proxy subdomain (`api` → http://api.localhost:4820).

shell.description: Command line handed to `$SHELL -c` — pipes, `&&` and globs work. Exactly one of `shell` or `cmd` must be set.

cmd.description: argv, executed directly without a shell. Exactly one of `shell` or `cmd` must be set.

cwd.description: Working directory; defaults to the config file's directory.

env.description: Extra environment on top of the inherited one. Values may use `${port}` / `${port:other}` templates.

autostart.description: Spawn on startup. Defaults to true; false leaves the pane idle until Start.

url.description: URL this process serves, shown in the UI as a link. Also pins readiness to that URL's port.

port.description: Pin this proc's assigned `${port}` to a fixed public number instead of a random free one — dependents outside the deck (dotenv files, mobile simulators, teammates' scripts) keep their hardcoded addresses, and an observed proc still binds a hidden internal port behind the HTTP observer. Requires `${port}` somewhere in the spec.

needs.description: Ids of procs that must be ready before this one spawns. Declarative: readiness is auto-detected, no port numbers in the config.

readyWhen.description: What "ready" means for dependents: "listening" (default) — the process tree opened a TCP port; "started" — it merely spawned, for procs that never listen.

observe.description: Route this proc's assigned `${port}` through procdeck's HTTP observer, capturing requests and responses for `procdeck http`. Defaults to true for procs that use `${port}`; false hands the proc the public port directly (no traffic capture).

shell.description: Shell command; exit 0 lets the proc spawn.

expect.description: Regex the check's output must also match. For checks that exit 0 either way — `wrangler whoami` reports "not authenticated" with exit 0 — so the config needs no `| grep` pipelines.

hint.description: What the human should do when the check fails; shown on the blocked pane.

preflight.description: A gate that must pass before the process spawns — e.g. `wrangler whoami` before a proc whose tree needs a Cloudflare token. Keeps interactive auth flows out of supervised panes, where a restart would kill their callback servers mid-handshake.

pattern.description: Regex matched against a rolling tail of the pane's output.

label.description: Badge text shown in the UI when the pattern matches.

items.description: A regex watched in the pane output; a match raises a badge in the UI.

alerts.description: Output patterns that raise a badge when they appear in the pane.
